opamp_partnumber.kicad_sch.description: Amplifier_Operational:OP1177AR (unlisted part number, 3 hidden no-connect pins) with R/L/C network; regression for library-category and pin-signature classification.

sim_spice_opamp.kicad_sch.description: KiCad 10 Simulation_SPICE symbols: OPAMP with '+' input on TOP and unnamed-pin VDC (polarity only in Sim.Pins); regression for orientation/polarity handling.

rc_divider.kicad_sch.description: V1 5V source feeding series R1 20 into R2 100 parallel C1 22nF to ground.

voltage_divider.kicad_sch.description: +5V rail through equal R1/R2 10k divider to GND with local label VOUT at the midpoint.

rc_filter.kicad_sch.description: Classic RC low-pass: global label IN, series R1 1k, shunt C1 100nF to GND, global label OUT.

rlc_series.kicad_sch.description: Sine source V1 driving R1 100, L1 10mH and C1 1uF in a single series loop to GND.

led_battery.kicad_sch.description: Battery BT1 9V through R1 470 into LED D1 anode, cathode back to battery minus; no ground symbol.

opamp_inverting.kicad_sch.description: Inverting op-amp: VIN via R1 10k to inverting input, R2 100k feedback, + input grounded, output VOUT.

wheatstone.kicad_sch.description: V1 10V driving a four-resistor 1k bridge with local labels A and B on the midpoints, bottom to GND.

logic_gates.kicad_sch.description: 74LS08 AND gate feeding one input of a 74LS32 OR gate: Y = (A AND B) OR C, all ports global labels.

hier_parent.kicad_sch.description: Parent sheet: V1 5V wired to sheet pin SIG of hier_child.kicad_sch; counts are for the flattened hierarchy.

hier_child.kicad_sch.description: Child sheet parsed standalone: hierarchical label SIG through R1 1k to GND.

big_200.kicad_sch.description: Generated 100-stage RC ladder (100 series R, 100 shunt C, one GND per stage) for performance testing.
